ticker.pick_prompt: Search or pick a ticker from the sidebar list.
ticker.seo_description: {name}: price, fundamentals, insider filings and the AI's read.
ticker.not_found: No ticker {ticker} exists. Check the symbol and search again.
ticker.pct_portfolio_help: This position's value today vs all your open positions
ticker.unrealised_pl_help: Latest price vs what you paid on average (FIFO, fees included). It can change until you sell.
ticker.history_failed: Couldn't load the price history for this ticker — try again in a moment.
ticker.history_empty: No price history available for this ticker — it may be delisted or very thinly traded.
ticker.span_hint_touch: Two fingers on the chart: change between two dates
ticker.span_hint_mouse: Drag to zoom · right-click (two-finger click on a trackpad) to measure between dates · ← → step through days
ticker.sma20_help: Price above SMA20 = short-term uptrend, below = downtrend
ticker.ai_analyze_help: Ask the assistant for a full analysis of {ticker}
ticker.ai_prompt: Analyze {name} ({ticker}): business, fundamentals, valuation against its history, and how it fits my portfolio.
ticker.ai_prompt_fund: Analyze the fund {name} ({ticker}): what it holds, its cost, the exposure it gives me and where it overlaps with my book.
ticker.ai_prompt_crypto: Analyze {name} ({ticker}): what moves its price, how it has behaved, its risks and what weight it can carry in my portfolio.
ticker.split_applied: The {ratio} split of {date} was missing: your {day} buy at {price} {currency} is {adjusted} a share in today's terms. Added to your book: {before} shares become {after}.
ticker.split_missing: The {ratio} split of {date} is missing: your {day} buy at {price} {currency} is {adjusted} a share in today's terms.
ticker.split_declined: You undid it, so it is not applied automatically.
ticker.split_failed: It could not be added to your book.
ticker.crypto_caption: Quoted in {quote}. Fundamentals, insider filings, earnings and DCF don't apply to crypto — those sections are hidden for this asset.
ticker.chart_annual_title: Revenue, net income & diluted EPS by year
ticker.annual_caption: Hatched bars = consensus revenue; dashed = consensus EPS (right axis) with shaded low-high range. Years without published estimates are extrapolated.
ticker.fundamentals_failed: Couldn't load the fundamental KPIs for this ticker — the data source returned nothing.
ticker.kpi_peg_help: Forward P/E over sustained sales growth per share. 1x or under is cheap for its growth; 2.5x is dear.
ticker.kpi_peers_from: Peers: median of {n} {name} names in the nightly scan.
ticker.moat_insufficient: Not enough statement history to score a moat — needs at least 3 of the 5 pillars (ROIC, margins, growth, FCF, dilution).
ticker.moat_caption: Evidence from {years} years of filed statements — the score sees what a moat leaves in the numbers, not its cause (brand, network effects, switching costs). A screen, not a verdict.
ticker.moat_detail_roic: Median ROIC {roic}, at or above 10% in {above} of {years} years
ticker.moat_detail_op_margin: Median operating margin {margin}; it swings {sd} pp a year and has moved {change} pp in {years} years
ticker.moat_detail_op_margin_loss: Median operating margin {margin} over {years} years — a loss is not pricing power
ticker.moat_detail_growth: Revenue CAGR {cagr}, up in {up} of {years} years
ticker.moat_detail_growth_no_cagr: Revenue up in {up} of {years} years (no CAGR: a year with no positive revenue)
ticker.moat_detail_fcf: Median FCF margin {margin}, positive in {positive} of {years} years
ticker.moat_detail_missing: Not enough in the statements to score it
ticker.insider_caption: SEC Form 4: officers, directors and 10% owners trading their own stock. Open-market buys (P) and sells (S) are the signal; grants and option exercises are excluded from the net.
ticker.insider_caption_bafin: MAR Article 19 via BaFin: officers and closely associated people trading their company's stock, notified in 3 days. Shares = volume / average price. German issuers only, 12 months.
ticker.insider_caption_cnmv: MAR Article 19 via the CNMV: officers and closely associated people trading their company's stock, notified in 3 days. Spanish issuers only, 12 months.
ticker.no_form4: No insider activity: this issuer has no recent Form 4 filings on record with the SEC.
ticker.no_form4_non_us: No insider activity: not a US listing and not in the BaFin (German) or CNMV (Spanish) registers. If it also trades in the US, open that ticker.
ticker.cluster_buying: Cluster buying — multiple insiders bought on the open market over the window and net flow is positive.
ticker.selling_dominates: Selling dominates open-market insider flow over the window.
ticker.chart_insider_title: Open-market insider buys vs sells by month ({ccy})
ticker.compare_note: Total return in {base} since the first day of the period.
ticker.compare_full: Six at most — remove one to add
ticker.compare_missing: No prices or no exchange rate: {names}
ticker.peers_none: No other names in this sector
ticker.related_help: People-also-watch peers from Yahoo Finance — tap to add to the comps table.
ticker.extra_none: No symbol matches that — try the company name.
ticker.medals_caption: 🥇🥈🥉 = best composite rank across the comparable KPIs (valuation, quality, growth, leverage — each metric ranked across the set, size ignored).
ticker.pick_peers: Pick peers to build the comps table.
ticker.kpi_sources_caption: Verification: SEC EDGAR (primary) > stockanalysis.com (10y ratios) > Macrotrends (15-20y) > Koyfin/TIKR (comps). yfinance loads the numbers; EDGAR confirms them. {n} KPIs defined.
ticker.pe_insufficient: Couldn't rebuild a P/E history — no quarterly EPS filings available for this ticker (non-US filer without an FMP key, or too few quarters).
ticker.kpi_pe_current_help: Latest close over the trailing-12-month diluted EPS known that day, from quarterly filings. May differ slightly from the P/E (TTM) in Fundamentals.
ticker.kpi_pe_avg_help: Mean of the daily trailing P/E over the selected range.
ticker.kpi_pe_premium_help: Premium (+) or discount (−) of the current P/E against its own average over the selected range.
ticker.pe_caption: Reconstructed series: split-adjusted close over trailing-12-month GAAP diluted EPS ({source}), updated on each filing date. Loss-making stretches are omitted.
ticker.pe_divergence: This reconstructed P/E ({cur}) is {diff}% from the Fundamentals P/E (TTM) ({fund}). Usually the latest 10-Q/10-K isn't on EDGAR yet; the series catches up on filing.
ticker.fund_ter_help: Annual cost of holding the fund, taken out of its price every day (TER). 0.20% on 10,000 EUR is 20 EUR a year.
ticker.fund_aum_help: Total net assets the fund manages. Yahoo often leaves this blank for UCITS listings — a missing figure says nothing about the fund.
ticker.fund_yield_help: Income paid out over the last year as a share of price. An accumulating (Acc) share class reinvests instead of paying, and reports nothing here.
ticker.fund_turnover_help: Share of the portfolio traded over a year. High turnover means trading costs on top of the expense ratio.
ticker.fund_duration_help: Effective duration in years: roughly how many percent the fund moves, in reverse, for a 1-point move in rates.
ticker.fund_top10_help: What the ten largest disclosed holdings add up to — the concentration floor of the basket.
ticker.fund_holdings_caption: The {n} largest disclosed holdings, {pct} of the fund — Yahoo publishes the top ten only, so the rest of the basket isn't shown here.
ticker.fund_no_holdings: No holdings published for this fund.
ticker.fund_caption: A fund holds companies rather than being one: no statements, insiders, earnings or comparables, but cost, basket and exposure. Your sector allocation looks through it.
ticker.cef_nav_help: What the fund's holdings are worth per share, struck daily after the close. A closed-end fund's price can sit well away from it.
ticker.cef_premium_help: Price over NAV, minus one. Negative is a discount: you pay less than the holdings are worth. Often lasting; it can widen or close.
ticker.cef_distribution_help: Current annual distribution over price. Part may be return of capital; the fund's Section 19 notices say how much.
ticker.cef_ter_help: Total annual expenses from the SEC fee table, over net assets. Includes leverage interest, so it runs higher than an ETF's.
ticker.cef_net_assets_help: Holdings minus everything the fund owes, from its latest monthly N-PORT filing with the SEC.
ticker.cef_leverage_help: Liabilities over total assets on the latest N-PORT (borrowings, preferreds, pending payables): a ceiling. Leverage magnifies income and swings.
ticker.cef_check_ok: {metric} cross-checked: {official} in the {official_source} for {date} matches {market} from {market_source}.
ticker.cef_check_off: **{metric}: the sources disagree.** {official_source} for {date} says {official}; {market_source} says {market}. Both are shown: check the fund's own site.
ticker.cef_check_none: {metric}: the {official_source} for {date} says {official}; {market_source} has no figure for that session, so it is not cross-checked.
ticker.cef_check_absent: The fund files no NAV or premium in XBRL with the SEC, so NAV and premium come from Yahoo alone and are not cross-checked.
ticker.cef_holdings_caption: The {n} largest issuers among {count} positions in the SEC N-PORT for {date}, {pct} of net assets. Bond lines are grouped by issuer.
ticker.cef_caption: A closed-end fund has a fixed number of shares trading above or below its NAV. Figures from SEC filings and Yahoo. No statements, insiders or comparables.
ticker.asset_stock_line: A share of one company: its price follows what it earns and what the market expects it to earn. Read the results, valuation and margins.
ticker.asset_equity_fund_line: A basket of shares in a single line: it rises and falls with its market. Read the cost, what it holds and how concentrated it is.
ticker.asset_bond_fund_line: A basket of bonds: it pays interest and its price moves against interest rates. Read the distribution yield, the duration and the cost.
ticker.asset_money_market_line: Cash that earns close to the central bank's rate; the price climbs slowly, almost in a straight line. Read the annualised yield against the policy rate and the cost, not the chart.
ticker.asset_closed_end_line: A fund with a fixed number of shares that trades on an exchange: it can cost more or less than its holdings are worth. Read the premium or discount and the distribution.
ticker.asset_crypto_line: A cryptocurrency: no earnings and no accounts, it trades around the clock and moves far more than a stock. Read the trend, the volume and the circulating supply.
ticker.asset_index_line: Measures a market; it cannot be bought directly — you follow it with an ETF or an index fund.
ticker.cash_yield_help: What the fund earned over 3 months, annualised, read off its price. What it earned, not a promise: it follows the policy rate.
ticker.policy_rate_help: What the central bank pays on overnight money. A money-market fund earns close to it, less its cost. Source: FRED.
ticker.cash_caption: A money-market fund is cash in fund form: no statements or comparables, and a near-straight chart. What matters is its yield against the policy rate, and its cost.
ticker.ai_prompt_cash: Analyze the money-market fund {name} ({ticker}): what it earns against the policy rate, its cost and risk, and whether it beats an interest account.
ticker.ev_cycle: Cycle events (h halving · e ETF · m Merge)
ticker.ath_help: How far the price sits under the coin's all-time high. A coin 60% under its peak is the normal state of the asset, not a tail event.
ticker.coin_weight_help: This coin's value over all the crypto in your book.
ticker.sleeve_help: All your crypto over your whole book. Usually 2–10%: under 2% barely moves it; over 10%, crypto's 70% drawdowns set the book's.
ticker.harvest_line: Selling it today would realise {loss} and save about {saving} in tax this year.
ticker.harvest_window: Buying it back before {date} would defer the loss instead.
ticker.harvest_blocked: Selling it today would realise {loss}, but you bought inside the repurchase window: the loss would be deferred, not deducted.
ticker.cycle_caption: Cycle context, not a forecast: these levels marked past tops and bottoms, and every cycle has broken some of them.
ticker.fear_greed_help: Crypto Fear & Greed Index (alternative.me), 0–100, from volatility, momentum, social and dominance. Extremes tend to precede reversals.
ticker.btc_dominance_help: Bitcoin's share of the whole crypto market's capitalisation. Rising means money is moving into bitcoin and out of the rest.
ticker.mayer_help: Price over its 200-day average. Under 0.8 has marked past bottoms; over 2.4 marked past blow-off tops.
ticker.w200_help: Price over its 200-week average of weekly closes. Past bear markets bottomed near it.
ticker.vol30_help: Annualised standard deviation of daily returns over the past 30 days. A large stock runs at 20–30%; bitcoin usually at 40–70%.
ticker.vs_btc_help: How much {coin} beat or lagged bitcoin over 90 days. An altcoin up 20% while bitcoin is up 40% lost ground.
ticker.vs_nasdaq_help: Bitcoin against the Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) over 90 days, both in US dollars — the risk asset it trades with.
ticker.halving_help: Bitcoin's block reward halves every 210,000 blocks (~4 years). The bar is progress to the next; its date is an estimate.
ticker.funding_help: What leveraged longs pay shorts on the perpetual every eight hours. Resting: 0.01%; well above is leverage piling long, negative is shorts paying.
ticker.open_interest_help: Value of the perpetual's open positions, in US dollars. The weekly change is in contracts, so a price move doesn't read as new positions.
ticker.positioning_caption: Read live from the first exchange that lists the coin's USDT perpetual. Crowded leverage has come before the sharpest flushes; it does not say when.
ticker.fdv_ratio_help: Fully diluted value over market cap. 1.0× = all supply is out; well above it, supply still to unlock.
ticker.analysts_caption: Sell-side consensus via yfinance — opinions with the brokers' incentives, not facts. Cross-check on Koyfin/TIKR before acting on a target.
ticker.analysts_none: No analyst publishes ratings or price targets on this name.
ticker.analysts_thin: Only {n} analyst rating(s) this month — under {min} is not a consensus, so no split or target range is drawn.
ticker.analysts_rating_help: Average rating on a 1–5 scale: 1 strong buy, 3 hold, 5 strong sell. Analysts rarely say sell, so a hold is lukewarm.
ticker.analysts_target_median_help: The middle 12-month price target, with its distance from today's price. Unlike the mean, one outlying target cannot drag it.
ticker.analysts_dispersion_help: (Highest − lowest target) / mean target. The wider, the less the average means: analysts disagree on the company's worth.
ticker.analysts_wide: The targets span more than the mean target itself: analysts disagree widely, and the average says little.
ticker.analysts_raising: Analysts have raised EPS estimates for both fiscal years over the last 30 days.
ticker.analysts_cutting: Analysts have cut EPS estimates for both fiscal years over the last 30 days.
ticker.analysts_revisions_caption: How the consensus EPS for each fiscal year has moved, and how many analysts revised it up (↑) or down (↓). The direction of revisions tends to say more than the rating.
ticker.dcf_help: Free cash flow to the firm, 5 years at the growth shown, then Gordon terminal value; less net debt, per diluted share. Not advice.
ticker.dcf_reason_negative_fcf: No DCF: free cash flow over the last year was not positive.
ticker.dcf_reason_lens: No DCF: free cash flow is not owner cash for banks, insurers, REITs or utilities.
ticker.dcf_reason_not_equity: No DCF: only for company shares.
ticker.dcf_reason_no_data: No DCF: the filings lack the share count, net debt or a currency rate.
ticker.dcf_refused: No value: terminal growth must stay under WACC.
ticker.dcf_grid: Value per share by WACC (rows) and terminal growth (columns)
ticker.dcf_growth_fcf_cagr: Growth starts at the filed free cash flow's yearly rate ({growth} %), kept between 0 and 15 %.
ticker.dcf_growth_revenue_cagr: Growth starts at the filed sales' yearly rate ({growth} %), kept between 0 and 15 %.
ticker.dcf_growth_fallback: No usable history: growth starts at a quiet {growth} %.
